title: Writing Task 2: Advantages and Disadvantages
focus: Ponderar ganhos e custos sem generalizações

content.text: Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
Ao final da aula você consegue:
fazer um plano equilibrado e escrever um parágrafo que compara vantagens e desvantagens com linguagem cautelosa.
Uma vantagem e uma desvantagem de:
living abroad · online shopping · having a car in a big city · working while studying
you learn a new language quickly
→ online shopping / it saves time / you can't try products on → a car / freedom to travel / high costs and traffic
dê uma solução específica para o desperdício de comida.
advantage · benefit · merit · upside · a major advantage is… · … is beneficial because… · one of the main benefits of… is…
disadvantage · drawback · downside · a major drawback is… · … can be detrimental to… (prejudicial)
the advantages outweigh the disadvantages · the benefits are greater than the costs · on balance, … · overall, … · the drawbacks are relatively minor compared with…
a large number of young people
tend to · it could be argued that · to some extent
On balance, the benefits clearly outweigh the drawbacks, although some people may find it difficult at first.

explanations.general: Correct answer: after considering all the points

questions.questionText: Too much screen time can be ______ to sleep. (prejudicial — d…)

explanations.general: Too much screen time can be detrimental to sleep.

options.text: Everyone who lives abroad feels lonely.
Many people who live abroad may feel lonely at first.

explanations.general: Correct answer: Many people who live abroad may feel lonely at first.

questions.questionText: The ______ of online shopping is that you can't try clothes on. (desvantagem — d…)

explanations.general: The downside of online shopping is…

questions.questionText: “Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?” You must…

options.text: compare both and decide which is greater

explanations.general: Correct answer: compare both and decide which is greater

content.text: → apresente os dois (opinião é opcional, mas uma conclusão equilibrada ajuda).
Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
I believe the advantages clearly outweigh…
More and more people are choosing to work from home. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
Admittedly, working from home has some drawbacks. Employees
feel isolated without daily contact with colleagues, and
find it difficult to separate their work and personal lives.
, remote workers save the time and money they would spend commuting, which
reduce stress and give them more time for their families.
be more productive because they face fewer interruptions.
1. Young people never read books. 2. Tourism always damages the environment. 3. Online courses will replace universities. 4. All workers are more productive at home.
Some families choose to have their children educated at home rather than at school. Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
→ Decisão · Body 1 (lado mais fraco + concessão) · Body 2 (lado mais forte) · conclusão
Public transport is cheaper than driving.
Living in a small town is safer.

options.text: Many young people read fewer books than previous generations.
Young people never ever read books.

explanations.general: Correct answer: Many young people read fewer books than previous generations.

options.text: Online courses will definitely replace universities.
Online courses may replace some traditional university courses.

explanations.general: Correct answer: Online courses may replace some traditional university courses.

questions.questionText: In the model, where are the drawbacks presented?

explanations.A: Correto: o lado mais fraco vem antes.

questions.questionText: These problems are relatively ______ compared with the benefits. (pequenos — m…)
Which is the writer's decision in the model?

explanations.general: Correct answer: Advantages clearly outweigh disadvantages

questions.questionText: Remote workers ______ to be more productive. (costumam — t…)

explanations.general: Remote workers tend to be more productive.

content.text: In many countries, more young people are choosing to take a gap year (a year off) before starting university. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
Decisão: ______ · Lado mais fraco (2 pontos): ______ · Lado mais forte (2 pontos + exemplo): ______
(≈120 palavras) no estilo do modelo + conclusão (1–2 frases).
Circule as expressões de hedging. Há alguma generalização (
[ ] Concessão do lado mais fraco + desenvolvimento do lado mais forte?
Reescreva 10 frases exageradas de forma cautelosa.
Liste 3 vantagens e 3 desvantagens para 5 temas (gap year, home office, tourism, online learning, living abroad).
What are the advantages and disadvantages of a gap year?
Avalie o ensaio: decisão clara? hedging? exemplos?

questions.questionText: Which phrase introduces your final decision?
A gap year can be ______ because students gain work experience. (benéfico — b…)

explanations.general: A gap year can be beneficial…

questions.questionText: Hedge: “Gap years always delay students' careers.”

options.text: In some cases, a gap year may delay a student's career.
Gap years always and completely delay careers.

explanations.general: Correct answer: In some cases, a gap year may delay a student's career.

questions.questionText: Admittedly, there are some ______. (desvantagens — d…, plural)
In an “outweigh” essay, you can avoid giving a decision.

explanations.general: Falso: você precisa decidir qual lado pesa mais.

content.text: 1 Many young people read fewer books than before. 2 Tourism can damage the environment. 3 Online courses may replace some traditional courses. 4 Many workers are more productive at home.
Although a gap year can delay graduation, I believe its benefits — maturity, work experience and clearer career goals — outweigh this disadvantage.
